The '''camouflage poncho''' was a simple garment that was made out of a rugged type of cloth. It had a mottled pattern of colors designed to allow the wearer to blend into the surroundings. They usually came in arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, or swamp terrains. It did not provide any additional protection.
